source.original_question:
Four small semicircles each with the same radius, and one large semicircle. The perimeter of the whole shape is 14\pi  units.
The entire shape is to be enlarged by a factor of 5 to form a logo sticker on the window of a shop front. What area of the shop front window will the sticker take up?

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: Let each smallradiusr; largeradius4r. Perimeter=4πr+4πr=8πr=14π, so r=7/4 andR=7. Two added and two removed smallsemicircles cancel in area, leaving49π/2. Enlargementfactor5 multipliesareaby25, yielding1225π/2squareunits.
